comment: The first line spells its keyword with LONG S (U+017F), which NetHack's parser rejects as an unknown config statement. The recorder (scripts/record-session.mjs recordSegment()) matches the keyword after JavaScript toUpperCase(), which maps LONG S to S, so it reads the line as OPTIONS and passes "-u Wendeline"; sys/unix/unixmain.c process_options() (385-396) copies that over the configured name after initoptions(), and the game greets Wendeline (js/unixmain.js parseNethackrcName(), process_options()).
